subject.title: feat: Let users steer running ACP/sub-agent sessions from Discord (and other chat surfaces)

question: Should ordinary Discord and bound ACP thread messages bypass busy reply-operation/channel admission to reach active-run queue policy by default, and should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89238 be refreshed as that canonical path?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but the permanent behavior changes message ordering, session-state ownership, and fallback semantics, so maintainer intent is needed before automation should implement or duplicate the admission-layer change.

options.title: Refresh the admission PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89238 or a replacement branch as the canonical path, rebased over current main with fallback and stale-operation recovery semantics preserved.

options.title: Keep steering command-only for now
options.body: Document that ordinary bound-thread messages still queue while explicit steering commands remain the supported recovery path until the routing contract is redesigned.

options.title: Split Discord ACP from the broader queue issue
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/48003 canonical for general steer admission and track only Discord ACP/sub-agent thread semantics here.

recommendation.title: Refresh the admission PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89238 or a replacement branch as the canonical path, rebased over current main with fallback and stale-operation recovery semantics preserved.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent related work put Vincent closest to the reply admission and active-run steering decision surface.
